author: Atdit
body:
Hello Avicus Staff team!

Today I'm trying my luck. I want to appeal my perm. ban for "DDoS and Ban evading multiple times"
First I want to clear up what happened when I 'ddos'ed'. I can guarantee now, that all what I write in THIS appeal is 100% true, if anyone of the staff team has a question, then please ask me! I only ddos'ed one single member of the Aviucs community, and not multiple times! It was only D00ZIE, now known as Dripin_ who got ddos'ed for about 1-2 minutes by me. I NEVER ddos'ed somebody else except him. And if you want to know why, then please ask me. I can explain it. The infraction https://avicus.net/infractions/106900 is COMPLETY wrong because I never ddos'ed DoctaPop, that's why another perm. ban of me got appealed a second time. If you still think that I have 3 perm bans., then you think wrong. Only 2 of them are legit bans. Now to the Ban evading infraction. Why did I ban evade that much? (I ban evaded on all my other accounts, even of some of my friends, sometimes with a hided IP and sometimes not.) I can explain this: Once I got temp. banned for https://avicus.net/infractions/124500 "Startistical Abuse, boosting.", I got very mad because I did the same thing which was "forbidden" MULTIPLE times before I got banned for it, even with many mods in my lobby, which didn't told me it was wrong/they didn't even warn me. So to explain the situation: I was 'abusing' my other accounts (alts) to start Avicade faster (a gamemode after the "Avicore" update.) After many times using it, I got banned for it + I got really mad and started to ban evade. I got banned then again and again, so I was raging about it and ban evaded again. Yesterday when I played some Minecraft, I saw the Avicus server on my server list and joined after 2 months not ban evading Avicus with one of my friends account. I'm sorry for it because I really wanted to write an appeal before I ban evade once again. And I'm making my appeal now, because I can't wait to get unbanned on my main account, and play with good old friends, which I really miss much.

Now to the appeal "informations"

I waited exactly 7 months and 4 days at the date when I got banned on my main account to write this appeal. I think and hope, that this is a long time. You will maybe think now how many times I've been ban evading. In hours, I guess about 6 hours ban evading, distributed on multiple accounts.
I'm very sorry for ban evading that much but honestly, I only did it because I wanted to play again and again a funny nebula game with my friends, and not because I was like "Stupid Staff, they are all retarded noobs!". To clarify that, I tried to help the Avicus server with its problems. Such as "Reporting bugs on GitHub, etc.. I even made an own musicbot for the Avicus teamspeak-community, but as Fluenza_ (jozzy), retired from staff, a few months ago, this suggestion got forgotten.

Do I deserve to be unbanned now, if my last ban evasion was yesterday?

Greetings,
Atdit.

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to appeal your infraction. You have been waiting for 7 months, and I am willing to let you enjoy Avicus again. Please don't make me regret appealing you. You only have one chance, don't screw it up. I'll leave this here for you to read. avicus.net/rules.

Regards,
Pelpelajax 
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
